$comment: URL naming policy for mitipi.eu (see docs/SEO-GEO.md). Rules are enforced by tests/unit/geo-assets.test.mjs; target handles are applied to Shopify with scripts/apply-url-policy.mjs (dry-run by default). Current handles live in config/languages.json; this file only states the target state and the rationale.

rules.charset: lowercase ASCII a-z, 0-9 and single hyphens; transliterate accents (é→e, ü→ue in German, ě→e)
rules.structure: https://mitipi.eu[/locale-prefix]/{pages|products}/{handle} — one canonical URL per language, locale prefix from Shopify Markets (en = no prefix)
rules.productHandle: entity token first, then the category term in that language: kevin-{category}
rules.pageHandle: the page topic in that language (its primary query term), no brand prefix, no stopwords
rules.stopwords: drop articles and function words unless the phrase is unnatural without them (fr: comment-ca-marche keeps 'ca')
rules.stability: never rename without a 301 redirect from the old path and from every legacy handle; never rename twice in a year
rules.tokens: one token = one word a person would type; brand tokens: kevin, mitipi

kevin-plus.$comment: Current EN handle 'kevin-plus' is a legacy name from the retired Kevin+ subscription; the device sold is KEVIN 3.

kevin-front-cover.$comment: Secondary product (add-on covers); EN handle already carries entity + category tokens.

pages.$comment: Page handles already follow the policy (language-native topic tokens, ASCII, hyphenated). Kept as-is on purpose: they were renamed once already (see languages.json legacyHandles) and a second rename would only churn the index.
